meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动分析 GitHub 仓库中的大量 issue，按根本原因将它们分组到少数几个“计划主 issue”中，关闭子 issue 并添加重定向评论，最后生成能一次性关闭整个分组的 PR。
howto.when: 当仓库有 20 个以上 open issue 且很多看起来重复，或用户要求“分类”、“合并”、“分组”、“去重”或“制定计划”时触发。

say.text: 帮我分类这个仓库里所有 open issue，按根本原因分组。
这个新 bug 属于哪个现有计划？
say.note: Claude 会匹配症状并追加到对应计划主 issue。

say.text: 为计划 02 生成一个 PR，关闭所有子 issue。
say.note: Claude 会创建 PR 并自动关闭子 issue。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically analyzes GitHub issues, groups them by root cause into a few plan-master issues, closes child issues with a redirect comment, and generates a PR that closes the entire cluster atomically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the repo has 20+ open issues that appear duplicate, or when the user asks to triage, consolidate, cluster, dedupe, or make a plan from the issue list.

say_en.text: Triage all open issues in this repo by root cause.
say_en.note: Claude reads all issues and creates plan-master issues.

say_en.text: Which existing plan does this new bug belong to?
say_en.note: Claude matches symptoms and appends to the corresponding master.

say_en.text: Generate a PR for plan 02 that closes all child issues.
say_en.note: Claude creates a PR and auto-closes child issues.
